scope: Isolated pre-failure1975-law numerical realization; not a public model or1977 variant

formulation_choices.stress_scope: total, restricted uncoupled mechanical/zero-pore-pressure embedding; no fluid interpretation or source total/effective decomposition claimed
formulation_choices.sampling: all coefficients evaluated at endpoint stress
formulation_choices.discretization: backward-Euler Eq19, only positive newly reached f beyond committed h>=ft
formulation_choices.kappa2: evaluate at current f then hold fixed in potential stress gradient
history: signed history-gap carrier q decoding physical H
wp accumulated local Eq19 work density
formulation_choices.initial_example: sigma=100000I Pa,q=ft-27,wp0 canonical reference to start of shearing
formulation_choices.minimum_ties: lazy-select exact min; (trace-max)/2 at double minimum, trace/3 hydrostatic; Clarke cluster-average generalized Jacobian, not classical directional derivative
formulation_choices.hold: zero mechanical increment gives identical state; no physical clock

qualification_before_approval: independent source-gradient and Euler work checks
exact hydrostatic elastic endpoint and proportional-stress no-plasticity checks
decreasing pressure and repeated-eigenvalue branch paths
step refinement toward independently stress-driven differential reference

early_gates.validation_generation: must validate exact candidate and generate standalone normal engine

path_gate_policy: Freeze separate converged reference/tolerances before compiled path results; early gates alone cannot qualify full model.
failure_policy: Retain failures; no implicit stress perturbation, clipping, coefficient freezing or pressure regularization.

history_representation.carrier: signed persistent q; negative values are explicitly noncanonical aliases of zero physical gap
history_representation.evolution: q=max(Hprev-f(S),0) for nonzero supplied mechanical increment; q=qprev at exact zero increment to preserve every persistent slot
history_representation.equivalence: Exact residual implies H=max(Hprev,f(S)); physical admissibility H>=f is structural; no physical state projection or invariant tolerance.
new_required_checks: signed noncanonical carriers preserve full state at exact zero mechanical increment
history monotonicity and physical restart consistency under finite precision
decode H for comparison with original source h; raw q is not a measured physical state
history_representation.unchanged_gates: All original numerical error/refinement/reference bounds remain unchanged. Initial strict physical H>=f is now an identity for the explicit representation, not a relaxed tolerance.
